findings.title: CSP `unsafe-eval` default fails open when NODE_ENV is not exactly "production"
findings.desc: `allowUnsafeEval` defaults to `process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"`, so any deployment where NODE_ENV is unset or set to something else (e.g. "prod", custom server, edge runtime without inlining) silently ships `script-src ... 'unsafe-eval'`; a fail-closed default (explicit opt-in, e.g. `NODE_ENV === "development"`) plus a test pinning the no-arg/default behaviour would prevent the relaxation from reaching production unnoticed.

findings.title: Truthiness guard still renders a bare "↔" row for partially streamed `between`
findings.desc: `t.between && ...` passes for `[]` or `["A"]` mid-stream, producing an empty or one-sided arrow row; guarding on `t.between?.length === 2` (or on both endpoints) would avoid the half-rendered artifact, and the new test only covers the fully-absent case.

findings.title: CSP `'unsafe-eval'` fail-open for any non-production NODE_ENV
findings.desc: The default is `process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"`, so any deployment where NODE_ENV is unset, `"staging"`, or `"test"` silently ships `script-src ... 'unsafe-eval'`; an explicit `=== "development"` check would fail closed instead.

findings.title: Default-argument behaviour of buildCsp is now untested
findings.desc: Pinning `buildCsp(NONCE, false)` makes the "no eval in production" assertion independent of the default, so an inverted/relaxed default (e.g. always allowing eval) would no longer fail any test; consider an added case asserting the production default with NODE_ENV stubbed to "production".

findings.title: Truthiness guard still renders a bare "↔" for partially streamed tuples
findings.desc: `t.between && ...` protects against `undefined`, but `between: []` or `["A"]` (common mid-stream partial JSON) still renders the arrow with empty endpoint spans; a length check would cover the full streaming case the test documents.

findings.title: `'unsafe-eval'` enabled for any non-"production" NODE_ENV
findings.desc: The default `allowUnsafeEval = process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"` also fires when NODE_ENV is unset, "staging", or a custom value, so a self-hosted/custom-server deployment that forgets to set NODE_ENV silently ships a CSP with `'unsafe-eval'`; an explicit opt-in (e.g. `NODE_ENV === "development"`) would fail closed instead.

findings.title: Regression test may be vacuous because `CollapsibleSection` is not mocked
findings.desc: The tensions block is rendered inside `<CollapsibleSection defaultOpen={false}>`; if that component renders children only when open, both assertions (`getByText('A')`, `getByText('Half-streamed tension')`) exercise nothing and the "does not crash" guarantee is not actually tested — mock it or open it explicitly as the other children are mocked.

findings.title: Doc de-referencing workspaceStore is only half applied
findings.desc: The header comment was changed to drop the "same debounced write pattern as workspaceStore" claim, but the section header a few lines below still reads "Debounced localStorage adapter (same pattern as workspaceStore)", leaving the stale reference the diff intended to remove.
